summary: Newspapers from 1912 and 1914 mention a lookout station on Midland Hill. No source describes its structure, and the hill is now a hiking destination.

access.note: Hiking Project directions begin with parking at Buena Vista River Park; the summit is reached on foot.

visit.trail_note: Five-mile out-and-back; Hiking Project directions begin with parking at Buena Vista River Park.

events.note: Forest annual report, quoted in a December 1912 newspaper, lists a third lookout station, classed as tertiary, on Midland Hill. No build date or structure is given.
Carbonate Chronicle reports the hill will be used as a fire lookout station once a new trail reaches it. Reported as a plan.

notes_for_editor: Only two newspaper mentions (1912 and 1914) and a trail guide. Nothing found records a build date, staffing, a structure or removal. County conflict: the record and the Forest Fire Lookout Association list say Chaffee/ Gunnison; the Forest Lookouts page says Chaffee County. The story names no county, so a human should decide the record's county. The 1914 paper's wording is paraphrased, and the trail guide is used for access only. Not corrected in the record.
